company.name: Zocdoc
company.shortDescription: Zocdoc is a digital marketplace company that connects healthcare patients and doctors.
company.description:
Zocdoc is a technology company that provides a better healthcare experience for millions of patients every month. Its online marketplace delivers the accessible, seamless, and simple experience patients expect and deserve.

Zocdoc was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in New York.

productsAndServices.description: A digital healthcare marketplace that helps patients find doctors, dentists, and other providers by location, specialty, insurance, availability, visit type, and patient reviews.
productsAndServices.name: Zocdoc Healthcare Marketplace

productsAndServices.description: A mobile application for finding providers, booking appointments, viewing appointment availability, and managing scheduled healthcare visits.
productsAndServices.name: Zocdoc Mobile App

productsAndServices.description: A provider-facing service that enables private practices to list their services, reach prospective patients, fill appointment openings, and collect verified patient reviews.
productsAndServices.name: Zocdoc for Private Practices

productsAndServices.description: A healthcare-organization service that helps health systems connect patients with participating providers and manage digital appointment access across larger provider networks.
productsAndServices.name: Zocdoc Enterprise Solutions

productsAndServices.description: Integration services that connect healthcare providers' electronic health record systems with Zocdoc for appointment and practice workflow coordination.
productsAndServices.name: Zocdoc EHR Integrations

aiResearchSummary.text: Zocdoc is researching systems for healthcare appointment information management, as described in 'System and Method for Accessing Healthcare Appointments from Multiple Disparate Sources,' which enables patients to manage multiple accounts and preferences through a single account. Additionally, 'Aggregatory System for Enabling Online Access to Encounter Data from Multiple Disparate Sources' details methods for synchronizing and aggregating encounter data across various healthcare sources. These efforts focus on unified access and data integration.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Private Equity round raised $150,000,000, or 39.9% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $10,150,082 to $1,924,411,280, a 189.6x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 78 (-11 over 90 days) and market heat at 63 (+6).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Healthgrades, Solv, DocASAP.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
